Assalamu alaikum wa rahmatullahi wa barkaatuh ..Dear Mufti sahab, once i saw a dream in which i went in hell, me and some other person was also thr wid me. i was inside the surface of the eart, its like a cave, when i climbed up and went on surface, i saw its like a Desert area, no way 2 go, and some skeletons handling knifes in their hands, moving ahead 2 me, 2 kill me, and from that cave, big scorpians were coming out and biting my legs, and those skeleton almost reached near to me. and suddenly i woke up.. plz tell me the meaning of this dream, thank you!.. 1328 views Q. By the Mercy and Grace of Allah, i offer five times salat daily with jammat, i have a beared, wear topi, enjoin tableeghi jamaats and try to follow as much sunnahs as i can, but never have i ever been blessed with the sight of rasulallah in a dream. I sometimes hear about some people who have just started practicing the deen and that too for a few weeks or so and in couple of weeks he is blessed with such a blissful sight, and to me many years have passed and i havent had such a dream. I do not mean that its my right to see the prophit of Allah in my dream or that i deserve it, on the contrary i feel i am quite a sinful person, but i want to ask 1) is there something that i am missing in my ibadaats or ikhlaas? do i have to do dua or wazeefa for it? 2)Does seing the prophit in the dream means that a person will be righteous through out his life? because i have seen people who have had the privelege of a such dream but they now rarely offer salat. 3) is it so that every pious person sees the prophit peace be upon him in dream? answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 39801 Country: India Title: Yesterday I saw a dream about one lion and one bear, both came to attack me but I closed the door quickly Question: Yesterday I saw a dream about one lion and one bear, both came to attack me but I closed the door quickly, after sometime I opened the door and checked if they are still there or not. Then suddenly bear forward his hand in the door, again I closed the door and his hand was inside the door, I forced the door and the bear take his hand outside. Can you say what the meaning of it is? Please pray for me. My parents are going for hajj this year pray for them too. Answer ID: 39801 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1010/613/L=1433) Your dream is nice. In-shaAllah, you shall be saved from enemies and jealous people. Be punctual in salah, recitation and zikr etc. May Almighty Allah bless your parents with accepted and blessed Hajj! Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
